name: Amlodipine + Perindopril
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Hypertension or stable coronary artery disease, substitution for the separate drugs
usual_adult_dose.dose: One tablet once daily in the morning before a meal, at the same perindopril and amlodipine doses the patient already takes

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated with diabetes or GFR <60; otherwise not recommended.
Not recommended; specialist only with close monitoring.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements, salt substitutes
key_interactions.action: Not recommended; if needed, monitor potassium frequently.

key_interactions.effect: Less blood-pressure control; kidney injury and hyperkalemia.

key_interactions.action: Not recommended; monitor lithium levels if needed.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors; tacrolimus, cyclosporine; simvastatin
key_interactions.effect: Higher amlodipine exposure; amlodipine raises tacrolimus and cyclosporine levels and simvastatin exposure.
key_interactions.action: Monitor; check immunosuppressant levels; limit simvastatin to 20 mg/day.

serious: Acute kidney injury (especially with renal artery stenosis, volume depletion, NSAIDs)

contraindications: History of ACE-inhibitor angioedema; hereditary or idiopathic angioedema
Second and third trimesters of pregnancy
Significant bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis to a single functioning kidney
Aliskiren with diabetes or GFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m2
Extracorporeal treatments using negatively charged surfaces (some high-flux membranes, LDL apheresis)
Severe hypotension, shock, left ventricular outflow obstruction
Hemodynamically unstable heart failure after acute myocardial infarction
Hypersensitivity to perindopril, other ACE inhibitors or dihydropyridines
monitoring: Potassium and creatinine (within 1 to 2 weeks of starting or changing dose, then periodically)

pk.half_life: Perindoprilat about 17 hours (unbound terminal); amlodipine 35 to 50 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Perindoprilat elimination reduced in kidney failure (not quantified); amlodipine unchanged
pk.metabolism: Perindopril hydrolyzed to active perindoprilat; amlodipine hepatic (CYP3A4)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Perindoprilat in urine; amlodipine 10% unchanged and 60% as metabolites in urine

sources.citation: Les Laboratoires Servier. (2022). Acerycal 5 mg/5 mg tablets (perindopril arginine/amlodipine) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA0568/018/001; text revised August 2022]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).

revision_log.change: Added SmPC 4.3 contraindication: hemodynamically unstable heart failure after acute MI.
